'''Star Tours Flight 519''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight that traveled to [[Carosi XII]] and [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]]. At the time of the [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138]], it was on time and set to arrive at 1050 hours. It was scheduled to depart again at 1145.
